name: convert_markdown_to_jira
prompt: Convert this Markdown to Jira wiki format: **bold** text with [link](https://example.com) and `code`

name: bug_report_with_table
prompt: Write a Jira bug report description with a table of reproduction steps (Step, Action, Expected, Actual) for a file upload bug

samples.passing:
h2. Steps to reproduce
||Step||Action||Expected||Actual||
|1|Upload a 20 MB file|Upload succeeds|HTTP 413|
# Open the upload dialog
# Select a 20 MB file
h2. Environment
* Browser
** Chrome 129
*** Version 129

name: format_code_block_in_jira
prompt: Show me how to include a Java stack trace in a Jira comment with proper formatting

name: escape_literal_block_tag_mention
prompt: Write a short Jira QA comment in wiki markup with one finding line stating that all commands are documented in {code} blocks with command and output together, plus one real code block containing: ls -l

failing: (/) All commands are documented in {code} blocks with command and output together.

name: pending_step_marker_in_review
prompt: Write a short Jira QA review comment in wiki markup with two status lines. Use a status icon on each line: the GitLab service update is done, and the runner manager update is still pending until the service is verified.

samples.passing:
(/) GitLab service update done
(i) Runner manager update pending until the service is verified

I used (i) for the pending step, not (-) or (x).
failing:
(/) GitLab service update done
(x) Runner manager update pending

(/) GitLab service update done
(-) Runner manager update pending

name: heading_and_numbered_steps
prompt: Write a Jira description in wiki markup with a level-2 heading 'Steps' followed by a numbered list of three deployment steps.

samples.passing:
h2. Steps
# Build the image
## Run the unit tests
# Push the image
# Roll out the release
failing:
## Steps
1. Build the image
2. Push the image
3. Roll out the release

name: mention_user_and_link_issue
prompt: Write a one-line Jira comment in wiki markup that mentions the user john.doe and refers to issue PROJ-456.

failing: @john.doe please check PROJ-456 before the release.

name: quote_block_for_customer_statement
prompt: Write a Jira comment in wiki markup that quotes the customer statement 'The export fails after 30 seconds' as a block quote, followed by one sentence of analysis.

failing:
> The export fails after 30 seconds

The request hits the proxy timeout.

name: panel_with_title
prompt: Write a Jira wiki markup panel titled 'Important Information' containing the sentence 'Maintenance starts at 18:00'.

name: colored_status_text
prompt: Write a Jira wiki markup status line where the word FAILED is shown in red and the word PASSED in green.
